reviewed_sources.scope: Published regular-file metadata admission, bounded independent stream collection, fallible allocation and error variants.
Published final-component NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK/CLOEXEC opening and read_opened_file delegation; no ancestor confinement.

catalog: Root compatible 0.1.11 requirement, inherited only in the Unix host package; no sibling path dependency or patch.
limits: Preserve public u64 limit and original RecordTooLarge limit. Convert to representable usize with saturation as before; supported hosts are 64-bit. Shared metadata is an early rejection; actual stream reads remain independently bounded.
errors: Pass IO errors through; map NotRegularFile to original IO InvalidInput; LimitExceeded to original RecordTooLarge; shared allocation/other failures remain typed IO errors. JSON decoder unchanged, including empty EOF.
custody: Reject final symlinks and opened nonregular files without waiting for FIFO writers. Trusted parents and concurrent byte custody remain local; ancestor aliases remain allowed.
lock_change: Add ic-host-tools and ten transitive packages; every previous registry selection retained. The pre-existing maintainer ic-metrics 0.1.9 update is preserved, not attributed to this adoption.
transitive_scope: Published archive/compression/Wasm modules and dependencies are nonoptional; this consumer invokes only the regular-file read boundary.

tar.scope: Corrected floor is published in 0.1.11; the actual locked consumer retains tar 0.4.46. No local override or suppression was added.

msrv: Dependency declares Rust 1.88; ic-backup remains Rust 1.91 and edition 2024.
license: Published MIT dependency used without copying its implementation; existing Canic/source attribution remains retained.

qualification.scope: Actual consumer production reader, native filesystem/FIFO/process-death and retained originals/reopen; no IC effects or macOS qualification.

compatibility: Private read implementation and dependency adoption only; existing public signatures, exhaustive errors, v1 records/digests/bounds, package 0.3.7 and receipt retained. Extend compatible pending 0.3.8.
unchanged_owners: record schema admission and JSON decoding
remaining: Native macOS qualification and future transport/other shared-tool adoption remain independent work. The reader grants no fresh authority, effect proof, retry, terminal or reference-release admission.

patch_review.scope: All published Rust source files are byte-identical between 0.1.10 and 0.1.11. Only ic-host-tools version/checksum changed in this consumer lock; all other entries retained.
patch_review.upstream_ci_limitation: Native CI fails in the repository tool-installer fixture because rg is not provisioned; MSRV passes. This is not consumer reader or native macOS qualification.
